LESSON: TOILETING

Grade: PP1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: MORAL 4.1 Islamic Etiquette By the end of the sub strand • Learners are shown pi
Topic 4.1.2: Toileting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Toileting. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify proper way of toileting in their day to day life
2. demonstrate proper use of water during toileting water. proper use of toilet (four different pictures i.e.entering toilet with left foot, use of toilet while sitting/squatting, leaving toilet with right foot and hand washing).

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify proper way of toileting in their day to day life
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify proper way of toileting in their day to day life. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate proper use of water during toileting water. proper use of toilet (four different pictures i.e.entering toilet with left foot, use of toilet while sitting/squatting, leaving toilet with right foot and hand washing).
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate proper use of water during toileting water. proper use of toilet (four different pictures i.e.entering toilet with left foot, use of toilet while sitting/squatting, leaving toilet with right foot and hand washing). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Toileting.
2. Explain Toileting to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Toileting.
4. Show that you can: identify proper way of toileting in their day to day life
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Toileting. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Toileting important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify proper way of toileting in their day to day life
2. demonstrate proper use of water during toileting water. proper use of toilet (four different pictures i.e.entering toilet with left foot, use of toilet while sitting/squatting, leaving toilet with right foot and hand washing).

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
